cases.goal: 解释课程里 row picture 是怎样用直线表达一个方程的，给我概念题和一道判断某个点是否满足方程的应用题。
checks: Each line is the set of points satisfying one equation.
New coordinate substitution is grounded in the demonstrated method.
Do not present one equation's solution as necessarily solving the whole system.

cases.goal: 根据这段课程，解释特征值与特征向量的定义，并给我两道特征值计算题。
checks: No eigenvalue teaching exists in the excerpt; abstain without invented course claims.

cases.goal: 我不明白为什么两条线的交点才是方程组的解。结合这段课程解释，给我一道概念题和一道纠正常见误解的应用题。
checks: Point on only one line is insufficient.
No unsupported claims about all possible systems or unique solutions in general.

cases.goal: 课程如何判断一条方程对应的直线是否经过原点？解释后，给我一道概念题和一道带不同数值的判断题。
checks: Distinguish zero and nonzero right-hand side as taught in this example.
The new example's expected answer must agree with direct substitution.

cases.goal: 只根据这段课程，教我用行列式判断矩阵可逆，并给两道求行列式的练习。
checks: Determinants and invertibility are not taught in this excerpt.

cases.goal: 请用这段课程解释梯度下降的学习率怎么选择，并设计两道学习率练习。
checks: Gradient descent is not taught in the excerpt.

cases.goal: 我常把横坐标与纵坐标代反。按这段课的检查方法解释如何避免，并出一道概念题和一道用负坐标点检查直线方程的应用题。
checks: Map x/y consistently; application has at least one negative coordinate; exact arithmetic; own citations demonstrate the same point check.

cases.goal: 先解释为什么只检验一个方程还不够，再出一道概念题和一道应用题：应用题给两个候选点，其中只有一个满足同一组两个方程，让我分别核对。
checks: Two distinct points; exactly one satisfies both equations; check both for each point; no answer leaked.

cases.goal: 按课程方法说明为何一个点不在某条直线上就不能成为这组方程的解。给一道概念题和一道纠错题，纠错题里的候选点要让两个方程都不成立。
checks: Candidate point fails both equations; avoid claiming every other point satisfies one equation; preserve same demonstrated checking method.

cases.goal: 只凭这一小段课，系统解释两条直线重合或平行时方程组的解有几种情况，并设计分类练习。
checks: No teaching of full solution-set classification; do not convert point verification into classification.

cases.goal: 只根据这一片段，讲解最小二乘如何处理两条不相交的直线，并给我两道计算练习。
checks: Least squares is absent; abstain without inventing course teaching.
